# The Vedic Story

> The Vedic Story is an Indian direct-to-consumer brand based in Faridabad, Haryana, selling traditionally handcrafted A2 Gir Cow Bilona Ghee online with free shipping across India. The ghee is made in small batches using the Vedic Bilona method and a commitment to Ahimsa (non-violence) in cow care.

The Vedic Story makes ghee from the milk of free-grazing Gir cows. The milk is set into curd in clay pots, churned with a wooden churner in both directions (the traditional Bilona method), and the cultured butter is slow-boiled over a fire to develop its golden colour, granular texture and aroma. The ghee is packed in food-grade glass jars, with no plastic.

Key facts:
- Product: A2 Gir Cow Bilona Ghee (also searched as Vedic ghee, desi cow ghee, bilona ghee, Ahimsa ghee)
- Milk: 100% A2 milk from Gir cows
- Method: Traditional Bilona, hand-churned, slow-fire prepared, small batches
- Ahimsa practice: Calves are fed first and only surplus milk is taken. The brand states no synthetic hormones or antibiotics, and that old or non-lactating cows are never sold to slaughterhouses
- Quality: Lab-tested; lab reports are published on the website
- Packaging: Food-grade glass jars
- Shipping: Free across India
- Location: Faridabad, Haryana, India
- Language and market: English, India
